(2) The toolbar's Admin button (dev-toolbar-admin-btn, DevAdminPanel.jsx) should stop duplicating comment-list/management UI and instead become a general Settings hub: user management (dev-users CRUD, already there), universal action/audit logs (already there), PLUS the menu customization currently in JynxSettings.jsx (orientation, icon size, reorder) folded in as one more section — read FORCLAUDE.md and JynxSettings.jsx/DevAdminPanel.jsx/CommentsPanel.jsx before starting, since this touches how those three already interact.
